manage_members.title: Manage tracked members
manage_members.description: Members are discovered from upcoming events, so anyone without events at setup time was not offered. Re-checked across every configured account — tick the members to track.

add_account.title: Add Spond account
add_account.description: Enter credentials for an additional Spond account. Members found will be merged with existing members.

add_account_members.title: Select members to track
add_account_members.description: Choose which new members to create a calendar and sensors for.

remove_account.title: Remove Spond account
remove_account.description: Select the account to remove. Members only found on this account will be removed automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Spond. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Spond to look up members. Check your internet connection and try again.

cannot_connect.title: Cannot connect to Spond
cannot_connect.description: Spond Tracker has failed to connect to Spond for several consecutive polls. Check your internet connection or whether Spond is experiencing an outage. The issue will resolve automatically when connectivity is restored.

respond_to_task.name: Respond to task
respond_to_task.description: Accept or decline a Spond task on behalf of a tracked member.

task.name: Task
task.description: The task's uid, as listed in the tasks sensor attributes.

response.name: Response
response.description: Whether to accept or decline the task.

snooze_task.name: Snooze task
snooze_task.description: Hide a task from the count for a while without answering it. Spond is not told; the snooze is remembered in Home Assistant only. A duration in the past clears an existing snooze.

task.name: Task
task.description: The task's uid, as listed in the tasks sensor attributes.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay quiet. Defaults to 24 hours when neither duration nor until is given.

until.name: Until
until.description: Stay quiet until this moment. Cannot be combined with duration.
